title: The Nihilist Reading Of Freaky Friday #Shorts
description:
The unconscious does not argue with Freaky Friday; it simply acts first. Freaky Friday is a comedic children's novel written by Mary Rodgers, first published by Harper & Row in 1972. The plot is set in a day in the life of 13-year-old Annabel Andrews and her mother, who spend one Friday in each other's bodies.

Reproduction explains more of Freaky Friday than any philosophy dares to admit. This was followed by runs at Cleveland Play House in April and the Alley Theatre in June. Disney Channel released a television film adaptation of the stage musical in the summer of 2018.
